If you are involved in a conflict of ownership, relating to an account on SoundCloud which you previously shared with another individual or group, we are unfortunately not in a position to mediate personal disagreements.

Please note: The owner of a SoundCloud account is considered to be the person who owns the email address used at sign up. We have this policy as we are based in Germany; meaning that we must adhere to German Data Protection regulations. This means that the individual who owns the sign-up email, owns the associated SoundCloud account and all related data. #### Next steps If you lose access to your shared email address, as well as your shared SoundCloud account, the first step is to attempt to regain access to the email address used at sign up. You can find out more about this process here. 

If you are unable to regain access to this email address, we are not in a position to pass access over to any other email address. If the account is hosting your Copyrighted content, you can report this via our Report Form. #### Need more help? If you are involved in an ongoing legal dispute with a third party, which involves the ownership of a specific SoundCloud account, please contact us at legal@soundcloud.com, providing detailed documentation from your legal representative.

Why You’re Being Prompted to Reset Your Password

If you were shown a password reset message when signing in, you need to reset your password before you can access your account. SoundCloud has introduced a new security feature to protect users from unauthorized access. This measure is particularly important following an increase in data leaks from other services that have exposed usernames, emails, and passwords. When SoundCloud detects that your email address may have been part of a data leak, you will be required to reset your password as a precautionary measure. This is to protect your account if you have reused the same password across multiple services. This is a precaution only, to protect users who may have reused passwords across multiple services. If you need help resetting or choosing a new password, read this help center article.

My Account: Profile Setup & Customization

Direct Support Links on SoundCloud

We introduced Direct Support Links after venues worldwide closed unexpectedly. Talking with creators, we saw how COVID-19 cancellations hurt finances, so we quickly created a way to help during these uncertain times. Direct Support Links let you add a single link to your profile, directing supporters to an app or site where they can offer financial help if you choose to enable it. Currently, we support links for donations, fundraising, memberships, crowdfunding, or direct sales of your music and merchandise. #### What are the best practices for promoting these support links and making them more effective? To ensure your support links are effective: Select the Right Platform: Choose a platform that your fans trust and are familiar with. SoundCloud currently supports platforms like PayPal, Cash App, Venmo, Bandcamp, Shopify, Patreon, Kickstarter, and GoFundMe. Promote Across Channels: Share your support link across all your social media profiles, newsletters, and live streams to reach as many fans as possible. Engage with Your Fans: Be transparent about how the funds will be used, whether for new music projects, covering living expenses, or other needs. This transparency can encourage more fans to contribute. #### How can I add a support link to my profile? 1. While using a web browser on your computer, go to your profile page on a desktop. 2. Click the “Edit” button. 3. Go to “Your links” and click the “Add fan support link”. 4. Add your preferred payment link. 5. Click “Save changes.” 6. The new support module will be shown like this on your profile.

How can I change or remove the Direct Support Link?

  1. To change or remove a support link, return to the “Your links” section on your profile edit page.
  2. Find your support link, make the necessary changes, or click the trash icon to remove it.
  3. Click “Save changes” to finalize your updates.

Does SoundCloud take a fee on these transactions?

No. We don’t take a fee or make a commission on any support offered during this initiative. Any money you earn through this is yours to keep. We are literally just letting you pick a link and making it super prominent. Keep in mind, however, whichever platform you use likely does take a fee, and you should familiarize yourself with their terms of service and fee structure to understand which option is best for you.

Display Name and Profile URL Requirements

Display Name

When selecting a display name on SoundCloud:

Keep it Consistent: Ensure your display name aligns with your branding across other platforms. This consistency helps fans easily recognize and find you. Make it Memorable: Choose a name that is unique, easy to remember, and reflects your style or genre. Avoid using overly complex characters or symbols that might confuse your audience. Consider SEO: Think about how your name might appear in search results. A clear and simple name can improve your visibility when fans search for your music. Keep it Simple and Direct: We have a maximum limit of 50 characters for Display Names. If you are hitting this limit, your Display Name will not save properly. #### Profile URL ##### When setting your profile URL: Keep it Simple and Direct: Choose a simple URL that matches your display name to help fans find and share your profile easily. Profile URLs must be between 3 and 25 characters. Using “SoundCloud” in your URL is also not allowed. Avoid Special Characters: Profile URLs can only have numbers, small letters, underscores, and hyphens. If you are using spaces or special characters in your Profile URL, you will be unable to save your changes. Think Long-Term: Choose a URL that you will be comfortable with as your brand grows. Changing your URL later can lead to confusion and broken links. #### First and Last Name

General Profile Troubleshooting

What should users do if they see a blank profile page after trying the suggested troubleshooting steps?

If you are still seeing a blank profile page after following the initial steps, such as upgrading your browser and clearing the cache, try the following: - Check the SoundCloud Status Blog: Make sure no site-wide issues affect your ability to load pages. - Disable Browser Plugins: Some browser plugins, like AdBlock or HTTPS Everywhere, can interfere with SoundCloud. To fix this, disable any plugins you have installed and try reloading the page. - Adjust Security Settings: Temporarily disable or allow exemptions for any pop-up blockers, firewalls, or antivirus software that might prevent the page from loading.

What browser settings can help prevent issues with SoundCloud in the future?

To prevent future issues when using SoundCloud: - Ensure Your Browser is Updated: Use a supported browser: Chrome 40+, Firefox 41+, Edge 15+, or Safari 8+. - Regularly Clear Cache and Cookies: This can help avoid issues caused by outdated information stored in your browser. - Manage Browser Plugins and Security Software: Be mindful of browser plugins, firewalls, and antivirus software that might block SoundCloud from functioning properly. Incorrectly allowing exceptions for these can prevent problems from arising.

Still need help? Reach out to our AI agent to submit a ticket.

Language Settings on SoundCloud

How can I change the platform language?

The language of the SoundCloud apps on Android and iOS follows your system language. If you want to change it, you will have to change the language of your phone or device. If you are using a browser to enjoy SoundCloud, you can adjust the language settings by taking the following steps: 1. Navigate to the bottom of any page on SoundCloud.com. 2. Click the current language listed. 3. Choose your preferred language from the dropdown menu.

Personalize Your SoundCloud App Icon

We are excited to introduce the ability for all users to personalize your SoundCloud app icon on mobile devices (iOS and Android), bringing a new level of customization and self-expression to your SoundCloud experience. This feature is part of our ongoing effort to make every interaction with SoundCloud uniquely yours. #### Why Personalize Your App Icon? Your style is as unique as your music. The ability to change your app icon to match your style is more than just a cosmetic update; it reflects our commitment to making SoundCloud a platform that celebrates individuality and creativity. We’ve learned that our users are passionate about how their app looks and feels. Your opinions are important to us. This feature was developed with your feedback and preferences in mind, reflecting our dedication to listening and responding to what our users need. Available Designs How to Customize Your App Icon FAQs (image: In frame.png) #### Available Designs Free Users: Choose between the classic orange and black SoundCloud logos. Go, Go+, and Artist Pro Subscribers: In addition to the classic orange and black options, premium subscribers can access an exclusive set of seven new designs, including chrome, rose gold, silver, soft purple, hot pink, tie-dye, and leopard. #### How to Customize Your App Icon Customizing your SoundCloud app icon is easy and can be done in just a few steps. On an iPhone:  1. Open the Settings page by clicking the icon in the top right of your Library page. 2. Select “App Icon” 3. Choose your preferred icon from the available options.

On an Android device:  1. Open the Settings page by clicking the icon in the top right of your Library page. 2. Select “Basic Settings” 3. Select “Change App Icon” 4. Choose your preferred icon from the available options. 5. Your app will restart as the change is implemented.

FAQs

Why didn’t the icon change? 

On an iPhone: 1. Open the Settings page by clicking the icon in the top right of your Library page. 2. Select “Troubleshooting.” 3. The application version is listed at the top. 4. The version should be 7.49.0 or above. 5. After updating to the newest version, completely close the app and open it again.

On an Android device:  1. Open the Settings page by clicking the icon in the top right of your Library page. 2. Select “Basic Settings” 3. Scroll to the bottom of the screen to confirm the app version number. 4. The version should be 253070 or above. 5. After updating to the newest version, completely close the app and open it again.

Are the new app icons available on both iOS and Android?

Yes, the customizable app icons are available for both iOS and Android users. #### How do I change the SoundCloud app icon on my mobile device? Go to Settings in your SoundCloud app, select ‘App Icon,’ and then choose your preferred icon from the list of available options. #### What icon designs are available for SoundCloud app customization? Free users can choose from the classic orange and black logos. Go, Go+, and Artist Pro subscribers have additional options, including chrome, rose gold, silver, soft purple, hot pink, tie-dye, and leopard. #### Is there a fee for changing the app icon? No, changing your app icon is completely free, and you can change it as often as you like without any additional charges. #### Can I revert back to the original SoundCloud app icon? Yes, you can revert back to the original app icon at any time by following the same steps: Settings > App Icon > Select the classic orange or black logo. #### Why can’t I see the new app icon options on my device? Make sure your SoundCloud app is updated to the latest version. If the app is up-to-date and you still can’t see the options, try restarting your device.

Profile Description, Web Links, and Location

To change your profile description or web links, sign in to your account and go to your profile’s edit page by clicking the small pen icon below your header image. Learn more: What are the best practices for writing a bio on SoundCloud, particularly for artists? How can artists link relevant content and manage other profile details on SoundCloud? How can users edit their bio and links on both web and mobile platforms? How do I change my location in my Bio? #### What are the best practices for writing a bio on SoundCloud, particularly for artists? ##### When crafting your bio: - Be Concise and Impactful: Use the 4,000-character limit to provide a clear and engaging introduction that reflects your personality and artistic style. Highlight key achievements, influences, and what sets you apart as an artist. - Include Relevant Information: Share details such as your background, genre, and any upcoming projects or releases. This helps listeners connect with you and understand your music better. - Add Links to Enhance Your Profile: Although HTML formatting isn’t supported, you can include up to 10 full URLs in your bio. Consider linking to your website, social media profiles, and other platforms where fans can follow your work.

How can artists link relevant content and manage other profile details on SoundCloud?

To effectively link and manage your content:
  • Add Web Links: On your profile’s edit page, you can add up to 10 links to share your website, social media profiles, or other relevant platforms. For example, linking your Twitter account ensures your handle is included in pre-filled text when fans share your tracks on Twitter.
  • Display Tour Dates: If you have upcoming shows, add a Resident Advisor or Songkick URL to your web links. This will automatically display your tour dates on the right-hand side of your SoundCloud profile, keeping your fans informed.
  • Customize Location Information: You can change your city or country by editing your profile. If your country isn’t listed, consider including it in your bio as free text to ensure your location is visible to your audience.

How can users edit their bio and links on both web and mobile platforms?

To edit your bio:

  • On the Web: Sign in to your SoundCloud account, go to your profile, and click the “Edit” button below your header image. Here, you can update your bio, add links, and manage other profile details.

  • On Mobile (iOS** or Android)**: Access your profile by tapping the three dots in the upper right corner of the home page, then select “Edit Profile” and “Bio” to make changes directly from your mobile device.

By following these best practices and utilizing the available tools, artists can create a compelling SoundCloud profile that effectively showcases their brand and connects with their audience. #### How do I change my location in my Bio? You can change your city, and or country on your profile via these steps: 1: Open up your SoundCloud profile here 2: Click on the “Edit” button on the right side, below the header 3: Change your city and/or country 4: Save the changes If your country is not listed and you need to include your location on your profile, we would recommend that you consider including it in another free text field, e.g., in your profile description, which you can edit through the Edit button below your profile header.

The Profile URL I want is taken

If you encounter errors when trying to claim a URL, first ensure that the URL you want is unique, as SoundCloud profile URLs are one of a kind. If the desired URL is already taken, add words like “music” or “band,” or use separators like ‘-’ or ‘_’ to create a unique URL. If you still get an error message or cannot save changes after following these steps, the URL may have been suspended and cannot be released. #### How can I obtain an inactive URL from an existing user? Our support team is not currently able to manually transfer an inactive URL. We suggest messaging the profile owner to request a URL change. If they decline or don’t respond, we cannot assist further. Some URLs may seem available but aren’t, which you’ll notice if the change fails. We cannot manually verify this as it’s a self-serve process. #### How can users report impersonation or trademark infringement, and what evidence is needed? If you believe your desired Profile URL is in use by somebody impersonating you, you can report it here. Additionally, if you own the live registered trademark to this name, you can find out more about what you can do here. Evidence such as proof of trademark ownership or documentation of impersonation may be required for the report.

Profile verification

Thank you for your interest in profile verification. We’re currently working on updates to the verification process to provide an improved experience. During this time, we’ve temporarily paused accepting new applications, and pending applications are unable to be processed at this time. While we know this may be disappointing, we’re confident that these upcoming changes will make the verification experience even more efficient and rewarding for creators on SoundCloud. We appreciate your patience as we work on these improvements, and can’t wait to share updates with you soon. Stay tuned, and thanks for being a part of the SoundCloud community!

SoundCloud x Resident Advisor FAQs

What is SoundCloud x Resident Advisor?

We’re integrating your Resident Advisor account into SoundCloud to make it even easier for fans to connect with your music. Your latest events, upcoming shows, and concerts will be featured on your profile, allowing fans to find and buy tickets directly on your page. This new feature will strengthen your connection with your audience by letting them quickly access your upcoming shows. #### How do I get my Resident Advisor events on my SoundCloud profile? 1. Go to your profile 2. Click the “Edit” button on the right-hand side of your profile 3. Go to “Your Links.” 4. Click “Add Link.” 5. Paste your Resident Advisor link and press “Save changes.”

What if my shows are displayed incorrectly?

Please fill out this form, and we’ll take care of it ASAP. You can also choose not to display the shows by clicking on the eye icon in the top right corner of the module, and turning it to “Hidden to all.” See below: #### My Resident Advisor shows are already displayed on my profile. Do I need to do anything else? Nope! If your Resident Advisor events are displayed on your profile, then we were already able to match your SoundCloud account to your Resident Advisor account. #### Can I opt out of this integration if I don’t want it? Yes! See the GIF above on how to hide these shows from your profile.

Spotlight Tracks & Playlists

If you wish to highlight one of your particularly noteworthy tracks you’d like others to enjoy first, we highly recommend using the Spotlight feature, which comes with the Artist (x 1 track) and Artist Pro (up to 5 tracks) subscriptions. Sign up today to utilize this premium feature. #### How can artists strategically use the Spotlight feature to maximize visibility and engagement on their SoundCloud profile? To make the most of the Spotlight feature: - Select Key Tracks and Playlists: Use Spotlight to pin up to 5 tracks or playlists at the top of your profile. Choose tracks that best represent your brand or recent successful releases to draw immediate attention from visitors. Consider featuring a mix of popular tracks and new releases to keep your audience engaged. - Reorder Spotlight Items for Maximum Impact: The Spotlight will be ordered from the most recent addition to the oldest addition. Arrange the order of tracks and playlists by dragging and dropping them within the Spotlight. This allows you to strategically place your most important content first, ensuring that visitors see what matters most to you. - Update Regularly: Regularly refresh your Spotlight selection to keep your profile dynamic. This can help maintain engagement by showcasing new content or seasonal highlights that reflect your current artistic direction.

What are the steps to add and manage tracks and playlists in the Spotlight feature on both the web and iOS?

Using a computer:

To add a track to your profile to your Spotlight selection, click on the “Edit Spotlight” button at the top of your public profile. You can then search for one of your tracks or playlists (within the latest 200 tracks and playlists on your profile) to highlight by typing in the title or selecting the track from the drop-down menu that will appear when you click into the Search box. The drop-down menu will only show the latest 15 publicly available tracks or playlists uploaded to your account. Once you have your selected items added to your Spotlight, remember to click the “Save” button. ##### Using iOS: - You can also edit your Spotlight directly from your iOS device by accessing the Spotlight edit mode, selecting your tracks or playlists, and saving your changes.

Please note: Private tracks and playlists cannot be added to the Spotlight feature. #### Removing from your Spotlight To remove from Spotlight, go back into the Spotlight edit mode and click on the “X” at the top, right-hand corner of the track or playlist. Click “Save” again. #### What should you do if you can’t find a track or playlist you want to add to Spotlight? If you’re having trouble finding a track or playlist: - Search by Title: If the track or playlist doesn’t appear in the drop-down menu, try searching for it by typing the exact title into the search bar. - Check for Restrictions: Remember that Spotlight only includes the last 200 items uploaded to your account and does not support private tracks or playlists. If the content you’re looking for is older or private, it won’t be available for Spotlight.

By strategically using the Spotlight feature, artists can ensure that their most important content is front and center, maximizing visibility and engagement with their audience on SoundCloud. Regularly updating and managing Spotlight selections can keep your profile fresh and engaging for both new and returning listeners.

Update Your Display Name and Profile URL

If other users are searching for you on SoundCloud, make it as easy as possible for them to find your profile by keeping your display name and profile URL clear, correct, and concise. #### How can I change my name or URL? You can change your display name and profile URL by visiting your profile page via a web browser on your computer and clicking the Edit button under your profile header. Please note: Changing your profile URL is not available through our mobile apps. You can choose whichever display name you want. Be sure to display it as you would anywhere else, and feel free to include spaces and capital letters. You can also add your first and last name if you wish.

To change your profile URL, click the little pen icon that appears beside your URL. Please note that you can only use numbers, lowercase letters, underscores, or hyphens in your URL. #### How often can I change my URL?  To reduce illicit activity on the platform, we have introduced limits on how many times users can change their URL within a given period. If you see an error, it likely means you have reached these limits. We suggest waiting until the following month and trying again, or reaching out to us via our AI agent. #### What happens when you change your display name or profile URL? Your new profile URL and display name will be immediately searchable on SoundCloud, but may not appear in Google search right away. This depends on Google refreshing its cache, and SoundCloud cannot influence it.

If you change your profile URL, this will affect all links and embedded players you might have posted previously. Embedded players that were posted before August 2010 will be broken. However, embedded players posted after this time will still play your tracks, but if the listener clicks through to the SoundCloud page, they will be directed to an empty page. We do not offer redirect services when you change your profile URL.

Please avoid using text within your Header Image as it will be cropped on smaller screens. - Once you have selected an image to upload, you have the option to drag the image up and down or to zoom in and out on the image. Share & Embed: Embedded players

Embedding a track or a playlist in WordPress

How do I embed a track or playlist in WordPress?

  1. Click on your track or playlist’s ‘Share’ button
  2. Go to the ‘Embed’ tab to preview the embeddable player of your choice, then copy and paste the shortcode into a new or existing post or page on your WordPress site.
  3. Then, add the shortcode in the Text Editor. Make sure to put the code on its own line in your post.

Please note:  If you have allowed downloads for your track and you receive reports that some users cannot download your content, they must be signed into their SoundCloud account first before the download option is enabled. Anonymous downloads are not permitted. #### My track is not embedding properly in WordPress, my website or blog, what can I do? First, make sure that you have selected the correct code when copy-pasting it from the Embed tab from the track or playlist’s Share button. Then, try to paste the embed code snippet in an custom HTML element. 

We also recommend not loading to many embeds on the same page. Finally, check if the track or playlist is still available on SoundCloud. It may be that the track or playlist is no longer available because: - It was deleted by the user - It was removed for Copyright infringement - It was hidden because the user went over their upload allowance - It was changed from public to privately available

If the track is available on SoundCloud and you are still seeing an error in the embedded player, please make sure that you are using a browser version that SoundCloud supports by checking our technical requirements. If you are using an earlier browser version, please upgrade it. #### My browser is up to date, what do I do? Please try loading the page after following these steps: - Check our Status Blog to make sure that there are not any interruptions on site that could cause you difficulties loading the embedded player - Check to see if the page loads in another browser i.e. Firefox, Chrome, Edge - If applicable, try disabling anti virus and any Firewall’s your browser may have installed

My Share button has disappeared, what can I do?

Usually the reason why the Share button could be missing is because of ad blocker or another third party plugin in your browser.  Please disable any plugins on your browser (AdBlock, Flashblock, Hola VPN, HTTPS everywhere, VLC Web plugin), since they might prevent SoundCloud from working properly. Additionally, please disable or allow for an exemption on any pop up blocker, firewall, or antivirus on your computer. You may also want to try a different browser if the issue persists.

Embedding a track or playlist

To get an embed code for your track or playlist, click the ‘Share’ button below the waveform and an overlay will appear. Click on the embed tab to view what options you have to embed your player. 

Copy-paste the embed code from ‘Code & preview’. Next, copy the code and paste it into the HTML editor section of your site’s editor. From there, a player will form, and you can check how many plays you get from your website or blog through your Insights page if you are an Artist Pro subscriber. Note: You no longer need a specific WordPress code to embed your player on a WordPress site. For more information, please read here. If you receive reports that some users cannot download your content, they must be signed into their SoundCloud account first before the download option is enabled. Anonymous downloads are not permitted. #### Enabling permissions for embedded players: If you would like to enable or disable your track to be embedded, you can choose to display the embed code through your track’s Permissions tab. Just tick the option “Display embed code”: (image: mceclip1.png) You can also enable or disable this option for multiple tracks at once through your tracks page.Click on the tracks you would like to enable the embed code, and click ‘Edit tracks’ and choose ‘Permissions’ from the dropdown.

If you want your track to be playable only on SoundCloud and through SoundCloud embeds, instead of websites or apps that use our API, please uncheck the option “Enable app playback”. #### What would you like to learn more about?

Embedding tracks FAQs

What are embed codes on SoundCloud, and how can they be used?

Embed codes allow your tracks to be shared on blogs and websites through SoundCloud’s embedded players. You can manage the visibility of the embed code, making it private or enabling it for anyone to share through your track’s Permissions tab. #### How can I manage the embed code settings for individual tracks? You can make the embed code for an individual track private or public by going to the track’s Permissions tab. From there, you can toggle the embed code settings as needed. #### Does making an embed code private affect existing embedded players? No, making the embed code private will not disable embedded players that are already in use for that track. #### What happens if I change my URL? If you change the URL for your profile, embeds will still play your sounds but, if the listener clicks through to the SoundCloud page, they will be directed to an empty page. We recommend to embed again your tracks and playlists.

The HTML5 embedded player

The HTML5 player is available to you as a customizable option to share your tracks and playlists. With this player you can: - Edit the color of your play button - Scale the size of the player

If you are a Artist Pro member, you also have the option to: - Show or hide comments - Show or hide recommended tracks

When you click the ‘Share’ button underneath your track or playlist’s waveform, go to the Embed tab and select the second player:

The Mini embedded player

Please note: the Mini embedded player is only available for individual tracks, not playlists.

The Mini Player is a smaller, sleeker option available to Artist Pro subscribers. Select between a light and dark scheme, and choose from a variety of colors for the play button and playing progress. 

You can access the Mini player through your track’s Share button in the Embed tab as the third option available: Please note: The background in the player behind the waveform is transparent. The dark and light color schemes are meant to make the player more adaptable when embedding it in darker or lighter sites. The schemes change the color of the waveform and text, helping it show up better on a darker or lighter website or blog. Enabling the dark option will simply make the font and waveform of the embedded player become white, and thus be visible on a dark background.

Track or playlist not embedding properly

First, make sure that you have selected the WordPress code when copy-pasting it into either the Audio or Text Post on WordPress. #### Only the Visual player embeds, even when I choose a different type of player (WordPress) It is important to identify whether your blog is powered by WordPress or is a WordPress.com blog. The former will mean that you can’t embed the HTML5 player. This is a known issue at the moment, and it’s caused by a change on Wordpress’s end. We are working with them on a fix for this. In the meantime, there is a workaround. Please try appending “&visual=false” to the end of the track or playlist’s WordPress code. This should force the player to render as the non-visual one. #### I’m seeing an error message on the player  If you are seeing an error message on the embedded player, check if the track or playlist is still available on SoundCloud. It may be that the track or playlist is no longer available because: - It was deleted by the user - It was removed for Copyright infringement - It was hidden because the user went over their upload allowance - It was changed from public to privately available

If the track is available on SoundCloud and you are still seeing an error in the embedded player, first make sure that you are using a browser version that SoundCloud supports. The lowest browser versions SoundCloud supports are: - Chrome 57 or newer - Firefox 50 or newer - Edge 18 or newer - Safari 10.1 or newer

If you are using a lower browser version, please upgrade it. #### My browser version is up to date, what do I do? Please try loading the page after following these steps: - Check our Status Blog to make sure that there are not any interruptions on site that could cause you difficulties loading the embedded player - Make sure you are using the latest version of Flash - Check to see if the page loads in another browser i.e Firefox, Chrome, Internet Explorer - If applicable, try disabling anti virus and any Firewall’s your browser may have installed

The Visual embedded player

Our Visual player emphasizes the artwork for your track or playlist, and has many ways you can customize the listening experience for your fans. To embed your track or playlist, go to the ‘Share’ button below its waveform. 

When the overlay appears, go to the Embed tab and you will land on the Visual player automatically: From here you can check out a preview of what your Visual player will look like, and copy the embed code to paste into your blog or website. #### Customize your player You can format your player to fit your blog’s iframe through the size range. You can choose between 300px, 450px and 600px. Once you pick the size you’d like, you can copy the embed code and paste it into your website or blog.

You  also have the option to turn on autoplay by clicking the box next to ‘Enable automatic play’. By doing this, your embedded player will play as soon as your website or blog’s page is loaded. Please note: Embedded players do not autoplay in mobile browsers. #### Features for Artist Pro members For Artist Pro members, your Spotlighted tracks will automatically be shown as related sounds after your track has finished, or if it has been paused. If you do not have any tracks Spotlighted on your profile, the player will recommend other tracks uploaded to your account for your fans to listen to next. #### Hiding Recommendations For Artist Pro members, you also have the option of hiding any recommended tracks from appearing when your track or playlist has finished playing. You can do this by unticking the box next to ‘Show recommendations’. Please note:  an embedded track or playlist with hidden recommendations will still display a message, after the first pause only, that suggests discovering similar tracks on SoundCloud. #### Hiding overlays Artist Pro members can also choose to hide overlay messages that may appear on embedded tracks or playlists on mobile or Web. To do that, simply untick the box ‘Show SoundCloud overlays’ when embedding a track or playlist.

Share & Embed: Share to social networks

Embedding a SoundCloud Go Track

On SoundCloud SoundCloud Go tracks are only available as 30-second previews in embedded players. As it is not possible to sign in to an embedded player, SoundCloud cannot recognize if you have a SoundCloud Go subscription to give you access to the full track. 

To listen to the entire track with a SoundCloud Go subscription, simply click the SoundCloud icon on the top right of the embedded player to listen from SoundCloud.com while signed into your account. On Facebook Sharing the link to a SoundCloud Go track on Facebook (Web) will create a visual embed containing a 30-second preview of the track. Hitting ‘Listen on SoundCloud’ will take you to the track on SoundCloud. Note: from a mobile device, any Facebook embed will appear as a regular redirect card that will take you to the track on the SoundCloud app, if you have it installed, or to the Google Play/Apple App Store.

Share music from SoundCloud on social media

Share your favorite tracks, profiles, albums, or playlists directly from the SoundCloud app or browser to Instagram Stories, Facebook Stories, Snapchat, Twitter, WhatsApp, and more. #### How to Share ##### iOS & Android 1. Open the latest SoundCloud app and find the track, profile, album, or playlist to share. 2. Tap the share icon. 3. Select the social media app where you want to share it. 4. Edit your story by adding text or a SoundCloud Giphy sticker if you like. 5. When finished, share it with your fans, followers, or friends.

Web
  1. Click the ‘Share’ button underneath the track’s waveform.
  2. Select the icon of the social media app where you would like to share it.
  3. Edit your post and share it with all your fans, followers, or friends.

Audio Snippets

From now on, you can share audio snippets of your favorite tracks via Instagram stories. Available on both iOS and Android apps. ##### How to share 1. Open the latest SoundCloud app and find the track to share. 2. Look for a speaker badge indicating Audio Snippets are allowed. 3. Tap the Instagram Stories icon. 4. Edit your story on Instagram with text or SoundCloud Giphy stickers. 5. Share your edited story with your fans, followers, or friends.

Please note that not all tracks in our catalog have audio snippets available, as this decision is made by the rightsholders and cannot be changed by us.

Track or playlist not embedding properly on Facebook

If you’re having trouble sharing to Facebook, such as the wrong image showing up or the track link not showing an image at all, this sometimes happens when updates have been made to your SoundCloud profile and Facebook is trying to reach the older information. 

To resolve this, you will need to debug your track link by copying and pasting it here. Debugging refreshes Facebook’s cache for your track, and show new information. Once you have copy-pasted your link, just hit ‘Debug.’ On the next screen, you’ll need to hit “Fetch new scrape information” :

Now all you need to do is copy-paste your track or playlist’s URL into Facebook. Please note: make sure to enable app playback through the track’s permissions page. You can find more information over here.

Track or playlist not embedding properly on X (Twitter)

If you’re having trouble sharing your track to X (Twitter), getting a “We can’t find that track” error, then this might be because you have previously uploaded and deleted a track with the same URL.

As this new upload has the same URL as the old one, X is getting confused and is going to find the deleted track.

For a quick fix you can add “?123” to the end of your track URL and copy and paste this directly to X.

However, this will not fix it for other users who may want to share your track. For this, you will need to edit the URL of the track slightly so it’s not the same as the deleted upload, just adding or removing one character will do.

You can edit your track’s URL through the track edit page on the Basic Info tab.

Once you have changed your track’s URL, your track will share successfully when copy-pasted into a tweet.

Share & Embed: Share your tracks and playlists

Playlist doesn’t have a Share button

If your playlist doesn’t have a Share button, it can be for three reasons: #### Ad-blocks or third party plugins are enabled in your browser If you’ve installed any plugins (AdBlock, Flashblock, Hola VPN, HTTPS everywhere, VLC Web plugin) on your browser, please disable them, as these commonly prevent the Share button from showing. Plugins can often block SoundCloud from working properly. Additionally, please disable or allow for an exemption on any pop up blocker, firewall, or antivirus on your computer. In the event that you are still experiencing difficulties, you may also want to try a different browser (Firefox, Chrome, etc.) to see if the issue continues. This way we can confirm whether or not this is a local issue on your browser. #### A track in the playlist is stuck in transcoding If you have uploaded multiple tracks in a playlist, it may be that one of them did not successfully upload all the way. You’ll be able to see this, as the individual track’s waveform will be grayed out and it cannot be played.

 If this has happened, please delete the track from SoundCloud and upload it again. From there, you can add the track into the playlist afterwards. You can learn more about how to do this here. #### A track in the playlist does not have embeds enabled If all of the tracks in the playlist are fully transcoded and available to play on Soundcloud and you are unable to see a Share button on your playlist, you should look to make sure all tracks in the playlist have embeds enabled. You can test this by checking at each track individually, and making sure they have individual Share buttons.

Sharing a private track or playlist within SoundCloud

Secret links are reliable and quick to use. They can be shared outside of SoundCloud, as well as in SoundCloud messages. On Web:

You can get the secret link for your track by clicking the ‘Share’ button below its waveform. Secret links have tokens (some extra numbers that make your link unique, unsearchable and unguessable) at the end of your track’s URL, so anyone with the secret link will be able to listen to your track. To share the privacy settings of your track, please follow these steps. On the app: You can get the secret link for your track by clicking the ‘Share’ button after clicking the three dots to the right of your track.

Sharing a public track or playlist within SoundCloud

When you upload a track publicly, or repost a track or playlist, the track(s) will display on your profile and in your Feed, as well as at the top of your followers’ Feeds. That means that anyone can listen, like, or repost it. A track will only be pushed to the top of your followers’ feeds the first time it is reposted or becomes public. You can get the link for your track by clicking the ‘Share’ button below its waveform. Private sharing is exclusive, giving you full control over who has access to your tracks and who doesn’t. Private tracks won’t show up on your public profile and can’t be searched for within SoundCloud. Artist Pro users also have the option to share a track as a scheduled release. Scheduled tracks remain private until the date which you have specified in its settings after which it will go public. This feature is only available for individual tracks and does not work with playlists. You can change the privacy settings of your track or playlist at any time. To change this,  click on the pen icon below the waveform to edit. From here, click on the bubble next to the word ‘private’, ‘public’ or ‘scheduled’ and click save.  The first time that you change your track from private to public it will be pushed to the Feed for everyone to listen to. This also true for any scheduled tracks. #### Sharing a track or playlist from the app To share a track or playlist you’re loving from the SoundCloud app, select the  Share icon on the track page. You’ll be given the choice to share in a number of ways: - Messaging bubbles (iOS only): You’ll see the profile pictures of people you follow to be able to easily share via DM by hitting Send To - Message: Share directly to anyone via DM - Link - QR code - SMS - Whatsapp - Social media - And more

SoundCloud Fans & Listeners: Discovering Music & Your Feed

Daily Drops playlist

New to SoundCloud. Selected for You.

Daily Drops is a discovery playlist that brings you a list of music recently uploaded to SoundCloud and personalized to your taste. Daily Drops is refreshed on a daily basis. It is available via the Home tab on web, and in the Home tab on iOS and Android. Daily Drops will recommend tracks that have been uploaded to SoundCloud within the last few days, based on what you like and listen to. ##### What happened to the Upload** playlist? We’ve renamed The Upload to Daily Drops. We heard that the past name (The Upload) was confusing for users. We decided to rename the playlist to Daily Drops, which is simpler and better communicates what the playlist actually is. Nothing has changed besides the name of the playlist. ##### What kind of content will Daily Drops recommend to me? Daily Drops** considers all the published tracks of the past few days on SoundCloud and ranks them based on your past activity to find the most relevant tracks for you. It uses machine learning to create a unique recommendation profile for each listener. Please note that the gap between the Daily Drops date and the published date is now set to be 30 days. We have increased this gap to give creators time and flexibility to master their craft while still getting exposure. ##### Will premium content appear in Daily Drops if I’m subscribed to SoundCloud Go+? As long as the content is relevant and matches your activity, yes. Free users will not see premium SoundCloud Go+ content in their Daily Drops playlist. ##### How often will Daily Drops** be refreshed? A new list of recommendations will appear in Daily Drops on a daily basis. ##### If I don’t listen to any tracks for a while, will ****Daily Drops**** still get updated every day? Yes, mainly because it relies on new content uploaded to SoundCloud. However, the more time you spend on SoundCloud, the better Daily Drops, as the algorithms will have a better understanding of which new uploads could be relevant for you. ##### What if I’m a brand-new user to SoundCloud? Will I have access to ****Daily Drops****? You won’t see it on the first day because we would first need to get a sense of what music you’re into. But the sooner you start listening to tracks, the faster we can create and showcase new music in Daily Drops for you. ##### Will ****Daily Drops**** change based on what I’ve been listening to recently? You may find more similar tracks in Daily Drops over time, but no, there won’t be a takeover of one particular genre. Our approach to understanding what you care about is not dominated by recent activity. Additionally, new content of a particular genre would also have to be uploaded and listened to by like-minded people for it to be considered relevant. That’s the other factor that meaningfully impacts what we show in Daily Drops. ##### Can I save the Daily Drops playlist to listen to offline on my SoundCloud app?  Yes, you can! If you are a Go or Go+ user, you can now listen to this playlist offline by following these few steps. ##### Can I share the Daily Drops playlist with other users? ** Yes, you can now share this playlist with other users. Just click on “go to your playlist,” and you’ll see the “share” option.

Music Intelligence Report 2026

You might have seen the broad strokes of what’s going on in music as 2025 wrapped up, but the Music Intelligence Report isn’t that.

The goal is to reveal meaningful insights through data, so we can plot the direction that music is heading this year. 

In the report, you’ll find out how listening habits are changing, and you’ll get to know a wide variety of scenes rooted on SoundCloud that are worth keeping an eye on. You’ll see why the headlines about hip hop’s decline are misleading — and what’s actually happening. And you’ll leave with an understanding of where electronic music is heading. Click here to check out our Music Intelligence Report 2026.

Related tracks

A way to find new music and audio is using our recommended tracks feature. Did you find a track you really like and want to hear more? Head to the track’s page to view Related tracks to play afterwards. You can find the related tracks on the right side of the track’s page.

Please note: There is not a way to remove related tracks from your individual track’s page at this time if it is public. If the track is private, related tracks do not appear afterward. #### How do related tracks work? Related tracks are selected by an algorithm that returns recommendations through a network of relations and interactions on SoundCloud (for example a user liked a track, a user followed another user, a track is reposted etc.). The recommendations for a track can be both directly or indirectly related to tracks in this network.

Search on SoundCloud

SoundCloud’s search makes it easy to discover new music and creators. Whether you’re looking for a specific track, artist, playlist, DJ set, or just exploring by vibes, search is the best place to start. The moment a song is uploaded, it becomes part of our catalog of more than a billion songs, artists, playlists, and more. Our search engine scans the entire catalog, factoring in text matches, current trends, and your personal listening preferences to surface the most relevant results for you. #### On Mobile - Tap the Search icon at the bottom of the app to open the landing page. - Discover what’s hot on SoundCloud by exploring vibes curated by our music discovery team. Hear the latest trending tracks recommended to you via Hot For You, a daily** recommended track on your Home. Check out our list of trending tracks **at your Home. - Or, simply enter your search term in the search bar at the top of the screen.

Search results are grouped and personalized for you. You can further explore each section by tapping See all or switching between the** tabs** at the top: - Top Results – the most relevant matches for your search. - Recently Played – artist, tracks, and playlists you’ve listened to recently. - Profiles – artists, bands, and fans on SoundCloud. - Albums – collections of tracks released as albums. - Playlists – curated track lists from creators or fans. - DJ Sets & Podcasts – long-form content from DJs, podcasters, and more.

On Web

  • Use the search bar at the top of the screen.
  • Type in the name of a track, artist, album, playlist, or genre.

Search results are organized into categories so you can quickly find what you’re looking for: - Everything – a mix of the most relevant results. - SoundCloud Go+ tracks – premium tracks available with a Go+ subscription. - Tracks – individual audio uploads. - People – artists, bands, or creators on SoundCloud. - Albums – collections of tracks released as albums. - Playlists – curated mixes from creators or fans.

You can refine your results further with filters such as: - Upload date – last 24 hours, last week, last month. - Duration – short, medium, or long tracks. - Tag – filter by user-defined tags, genre, style, mood, or theme.

SoundCloud Go/Go+ 

In countries where SoundCloud Go + is offered, you unlock an expanded, fully licensed catalog that pairs today’s biggest stars with tomorrow’s breakout talent from around the world. This collection spans both independent creators and artists signed to industry heavyweights such as Sony Music Entertainment, Universal Music Group, Merlin, Warner Music Group, and more. In countries where SoundCloud Go is offered, you unlock ad-free listening and unlimited track saves for offline listening, all for a lower price. Sign up now to explore it all!

Stations and how they work

Stations is a way to discover the tracks you’ve never heard anywhere else, making it easy to tap into a long stream of music related to your favorite tracks. It takes our previous “Related Tracks” feature and brings it further, simplifying the functionality and making your discovery even better. You can also find your recently listened to Stations with your Likes and Playlists, on your Library page. Stations is available for iOS, Android and web. #### Starting a station With Stations, you’ll get an endless stream of audio pulled from 4x the catalog of every major streaming platform on SoundCloud. A station can be started from any track, search term or your Library. Pull up the menu from the three dots on the right hand side and select the “Station” option. On web, simply hit the three dots icon underneath the SoundCloud player, or at the top right corner of any profile and hit ‘Station’: This is how it looks: On iOS and Android, you can also start a Station by clicking the three dots next to the track. #### Listening to a station again Your recent stations will show up in the “Stations” section in your Library, next to your Likes, Albums and Playlists.

What is Top Tracks?

Update January 9th 2020: We heard your feedback on our recently released “Top tracks” section and we have decided to remove it from the “All” tab on our website. In addition, we renamed “Top tracks” into “Popular tracks”, since overall play counts on tracks are not the only metric that feed into the underlying algorithm. Top tracks is a feature that we recently introduced on our desktop version that has previously existed in mobile devices. It drives a lot of engagement to your tracks including likes, plays, and shares and is a mix of both popular and recent tracks.The top tracks algorithm is updated daily and we only include engagement data from the past 90 days, which means that only recent streaming data is considered. If you are a creator, we offer the Spotlight feature which comes free with all Artist Pro accounts and gives you control over what tracks are at the top of your profile so you can highlight the work you are most proud of.

Your Feed and how it works

Your Feed** helps you discover new tracks and keeps you up to date with the people you follow. We have just released a major update to the Feed on mobile (iOS and Android), splitting the Feed into two tabs: Discover and Following. On the web, Feed will continue to just be the Following feed for now. Please note:** It’s only possible to see one post or repost of a specific track in your Following Feed. Initially, all tracks are “posted” by a creator in the feed; however, if someone that you follow reposts the track, the repost will be shown at the top of your feed and erase any post of the same track from another user if it’s further down in your feed. #### Mobile (iOS and Android) The mobile Feed is split into two tabs: Discover and Following. Both tabs are designed to make it easier than ever to get a taste of music before deciding if you want to listen to more. The preview you hear has been either hand-picked by the artist or selected by our AI tagging tool to find what is most exciting for you. You can click into a track to listen to the full song, or swipe down to hear the next track. If you finish listening to the full clip, it will play again from the beginning. ##### Discovery Tab: Your Home page helps you discover new music & artists, based on what you’ve liked and listened to and who you follow. Every recommendation is personalized for you and contains an explanation for why it was selected. The more you like and follow, the more your recommendations will adjust. ##### Following Tab: The Following tab shows new releases and reposts from people that you follow in reverse chronological order. You can also see what people have captioned their reposts in the Following Feed. You can unfollow users to stop their new uploads and reposts from appearing in your Feed. Any older tracks or playlists will also disappear.

Your Playback playlists

What is ‘Your 2025 Playback’?

‘Your 2025 Playback’ is a reflection on all the great songs, artists and genres you’ve enjoyed in 2025. It includes a new interactive stories feature that shows your highlights as well as the classic “Your Playback” playlists you have enjoyed in the past. #### Am I eligible for ‘Your 2025 Playback’?  ‘Your 2025 Playback’ is available for all users who have listened to enough Songs, Artists, Moods and Genres to complete each list of 5. This is usually only around 20-50 songs. #### I’m not seeing my ‘Your 2025 Playback’ All users on iOS and Android who meet the eligibility criteria should see it featured on their home page from the 3rd of December 2025. The playlists can be viewed directly using the links below. ‘Your 2025 Playback’ is only available for the latest app versions. To update manually, head to your app store, search for ‘SoundCloud’ and force an “update” if showing. #### What is ‘Your 2025 Playback?’ ‘Your Playback’ is a personalized playlist of the tracks you played most in a certain year. #### Where can I find my previous ‘Playback’ playlists? You can access previous Your Playback playlists here: Your 2025 Playback playlist Your 2024 Playback playlist Your 2023 Playback playlist Your 2022 Playback playlist Your 2021 Playback playlist Your 2020 Playback playlist Your 2019 Playback playlist Your 2018 Playback playlist Your 2017 Playback playlist Your 2016 Playback playlist Learn more about which playlists you have access to here. #### What criteria do I need in order to have a ‘Playback’ playlist? To have a playlist,  you must have had an account and listened to at least 10 different artists and 30 different tracks. - between January 1 and November 30, 2025 for “Your 2025 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2024 for “Your 2024 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2023 for “Your 2023 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2022, for “Your 2022 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2021 for “Your 2021 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2020 for “Your 2020 Playback” - between January 1 and November 30, 2019 for “Your 2019 Playback” - between January 1 and December 31, 2018 for “Your 2018 Playback” - between January 1 and December 31, 2017 for “Your 2017 Playback” - between January 1 and December 31, 2016 for “Your 2016 Playback”

Are my own tracks included in my ‘Your Playback’ playlist? 

Your Playback playlists do not include tracks you have uploaded to SoundCloud. #### Can I save my ‘Your Playback’ playlist?  Yes, you can! Just tap the heart and ‘Your Playback’ playlist will be saved to your Library. If you’re a Go or Go+ user, you can listen to this playlist offline by saving your playlist for offline listening. #### Can I share my ‘Your Playback’ playlist? Yes! Here’s how to do it on iOS and Android: 1. Open your “Your Playback” playlist. 2. Tap the share icon. 3. Tap the icon of the social media where you would like to share it. 4. You can make adjustments to your story - such as adding text - before posting. 5. Once you’re done editing your post, share it with all your followers and friends!

How are the tracks ordered in my ‘Your Playback’ playlist?

Tracks are ordered by play count: from most played to least played. #### My ‘Your Playback’ playlist includes music I didn’t listen to This can happen because: - You share an account with someone else - You leave SoundCloud playing in the background

SoundCloud Fans & Listeners: Fan Subscriptions (SoundCloud Go & Go+)

Free trial for SoundCloud Go subscriptions

When you purchase a** SoundCloud Go or Go+ subscription for the first time, you are eligible for a free trial. You can cancel the subscription anytime during the trial. If not canceled before the trial ends, you will be charged monthly automatically. Please note:** you may see a 0.00 or 1.00 entry on your bank’s e-statement after beginning the trial. This amount will immediately be put back into your bank account, as it is simply a validation that the payment details you provided are authentic and are able to be charged automatically after the trial is over, unless cancelled earlier. #### Who is eligible for the trial?  The trial is available only for your first time purchase of SoundCloud Go. Please make sure you have already confirmed your email address upon sign-up before your SoundCloud Go trial. If you have subscribed to SoundCloud Go in the past, cancelled, and then want to purchase again, you will not receive a trial and will be charged immediately. Additionally, the trial is only accessible in countries where SoundCloud Go is currently available. Check to see if SoundCloud Go has launched in your country. To keep up to date on where SoundCloud Go is being released next, check out our blog for more updates. The trial offer is not available in Québec, Canada: Due to local restrictions in Québec, we are unable to offer a free trial for SoundCloud Go in this region. If your purchase a SoundCloud Go subscription from Quebec, you will be charged immediately upon purchase. #### How can I cancel my subscription before I am charged? To cancel your trial, log in to your account and head over to your** **Subscription Settings on a computer and click the “Edit” button to manage your current subscription. Please note that it is not currently possible to cancel a subscription via a mobile device.

Get Started with SoundCloud Go+

While you can still enjoy tens of millions of tracks for free on SoundCloud, we’re expanding the platform with millions of tracks from major labels and independent artists, including full catalogs and the latest hits. Some of this content is available for free in full, while other tracks appear as 30-second previews. You can easily spot a SoundCloud Go+ track by the Go+ marker in the top right corner of the track. With a SoundCloud Go+ subscription, you get access to over 135 million tracks in full, including exclusive releases from top artists and indie favorites. Go+ also unlocks offline listening, ad-free streaming, and full access to all content on SoundCloud, so you can enjoy your music anytime, anywhere—without interruptions. Remember, whether a track is available for free or as a Go+ track is determined by the rights holder, so subscribing ensures you don’t miss a single beat. SoundCloud Go is now available in multiple countries. If your country isn’t listed yet, don’t worry! We’re expanding soon. For updates on new releases, visit our blog. #### Why has the Go+ subscription price changed? We are changing our prices to continue supporting independent and emerging artists on our platform. Not only does the price change help artists make more money, but it also helps us build new features that bring you closer to artists. If you are a Go+ subscriber as of February 28, 2026, you’ll have one more billing cycle at the current price before the increase. You can always manage your subscription in your account settings. #### Purchasing through our website To buy a SoundCloud Go subscription through our website, go to our purchase page. We currently offer these payment methods through our website: - Visa - MasterCard - American Express - Diners Club - Discover

Please note: we only accept credit or debit cards issued in SoundCloud Go launch territories. If you have an Artist Pro subscription, you’ll be able to purchase SoundCloud Go at a discounted price*. Read more about the Artist Pro discount. Please note: due to transactional fees, paying for SoundCloud Go through the Apple App Store is about 30% more expensive than purchasing directly with SoundCloud. If you would like to purchase SoundCloud Go at a lower price, please read further on how to cancel through Apple. #### Purchasing on your mobile device  To purchase through the Android or iOS SoundCloud app, go to your Settings page. - On iOS, you can access your Settings page through the person icon at the bottom of the footer, and then the three dots at the top of your Library page. - On Android, click the three dots at the top right of your screen and click Settings from the drop-down. - Note that you will need to have already confirmed your email address at sign-up before your SoundCloud Go purchase.

Click the SoundCloud Go purchase button to buy a subscription. Once you’ve purchased SoundCloud Go, you’ll see a confirmation screen from SoundCloud welcoming you.

SoundCloud Go Invoices

Where can I get an invoice after I purchase my Go subscription?

We send an invoice to the primary email attached to your SoundCloud account as soon as you purchase a SoundCloud Go plan. If you do not see this email, check your spam folder just in case it ended up there. If you purchased a SoundCloud Go subscription through the Apple app store on your iOS device, you will receive an invoice to your email from Apple directly. 

Alternately, you can also find a copy of your invoice through your Subscriptions page when signed into your account on a computer, if you’d like to print or keep it on file - please note that we do not send hard copy invoices. #### Can I change my payment details on my Go invoices? There isn’t a way to change the payment details on your current invoices. 

However, you can change the payment details by signing up for the monthly SoundCloud Go subscription again right before the next payment is due. You can check when the next payment is due by signing into your account on a computer and going to your Subscriptions page. You will not be charged twice for SoundCloud Go subscriptions in that case, but we will respect your new payment details for the existing SoundCloud Go subscription.

SoundCloud Go+ Discount for Artist Pro

At SoundCloud, we want our creators to have the best tools to make music and the best experience to listen to it. That’s why Artist Pro subscribers are eligible for a 50% discount on a SoundCloud Go+ subscription. #### Eligibility Requirements To qualify for the 50% bundle discount, you must meet the following criteria: - Direct Purchase: Both subscriptions must be purchased directly through the Subscription settings. - App Store Exclusion: Due to platform restrictions, this discount is not available if you subscribe via the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.

How to Claim the Discount

  • New Subscribers: If you already have Artist Pro and sign up for Go+ via our website, the 50% discount will be applied automatically to your next billing cycle.
  • Switching from Apple/Google Play: If you currently subscribe via Apple or Google Play, you must:

Cancel your subscription through the respective App Store. - Wait for the remaining time on that billing cycle to expire. - Re-subscribe directly through your Subscription settings . The discount will then apply automatically.

Managing Your Bundle

Changing your subscription status will affect your discount. Here is what happens in each scenario: - If you…: Then - Cancel Artist Pro: You will lose the 50% discount. Your Go+ subscription will continue at the full standard price starting your next billing cycle. - Cancel Go+: Your Artist Pro plan remains active at the standard rate. You will simply lose access to Go+ features (ad-free, offline, and HQ audio). - Cancel Both: You must cancel each subscription individually through your Subscription settings.

Common Questions

How long does the discount last? The discount remains active for as long as you maintain both an active Artist Pro and a SoundCloud Go+ subscription purchased via the web. Why is the price different on my mobile app? Mobile app stores (Apple/Google) charge their own transaction fees and do not support our internal bundling discounts. To ensure you get the best price, always manage your billing directly in your Subscription settings. Need more help with your billing? Check out or contact our AI Agent for assistance with specific payment issues.

SoundCloud Go+ for Students

SoundCloud Go+ Student is our discount plan for students. Student subscriptions are only available via SoundCloud directly and you need to renew after each year. To subscribe, click here. #### What is the SoundCloud Go+ Student subscription? With Go+ Student, you get all the same features as regular Go+ users, but only pay half the price. To start the process, you can find the link here. Student subscriptions are only available via SoundCloud directly and are not offered via Apple or Google Play stores. For sign up, we suggest either using a computer or your mobile browser. After sign-up, you will be transferred to our partner SheerID, who will assist with your verification. If a different email address is verified, which is not connected to your Student Plan subscription, the discount will not be applied and you will need to reach out to our support team. We have a limit of 5 attempts per month, which means after 30 days, you will be able to apply again. ##### What happens to my Go+ Student subscription once I am no longer eligible? If you’re not a student anymore (after 12 months), you will no longer be eligible for the SoundCloud Go+ Student discount, and you will automatically renew at the normal price of SoundCloud Go+ unless opted out prior. ##### How can I pay for my Go+ Student subscription?
